node.title: WCL slot 4,9 emptiness
node.statement: No reduced signed weight-9 polynomial has the four odd-power vanishings at order-2048 roots at any official row (ell=4 window; the deepest slot). FALSIFIER: one official-admissible prime (q < 2^256, v_2(q-1) >= 41) carrying the vanisher. Minted 2026-07-19 at the WCL amber ceremony; bookkeeping of record = the zone node's official_terminal_attack.md.
